title: Fix BodyFrame default right-handedness
description: Council multi-pass geometry review found that BodyFrame documents Binormal = Cross(Tangent, Normal), but BodyFrame.Default currently uses Tangent = +Z, Normal = +Y, Binormal = +X. Since +Z x +Y = -X, the empty/degenerate fallback frame is left-handed and disagrees with every transported frame. Fix the default frame to preserve the documented right-handed convention and add an empty-spline regression. Owner family: TSK-0024 BodyFrameResolver; this is a focused correctness follow-up, not a new frame abstraction. Unity execution is required before closure.
